query: 灵活工作安排 灵活工作安排 衡量企业在远程/弹性办公方面的制度与执行。 一、 内容质量得分 (权重 50%) 衡量制度的专业性与可执行度，防止“口头承诺”而无制度保障。 2分：卓越（三要素齐全） 制度清晰： 明确定义了弹性工时、远程办公或压缩工时（如 4.5 天工作制）的具体形式，针对特殊员工群体有单独的配套措施。 适用边界： 清楚界定了哪些岗位适用、申请流程及审批权限，具有极强的操作性。 绩效协同： 建立了“以结果为导向”的考核机制，确保灵活办公不影响协作效率（如配套的线上协作工具、核心协作时间规定）。 1分：合格 包含一个或两个 0分：缺失 未披露任何相关信息，或企业文化明确强调全员必须现场打卡且无弹性空间。 二、 覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%,) 衡量制度的穿透力，即多少员工真正受益。 2分：全覆盖与高穿透 覆盖率： 机制覆盖 100% 符合岗位性质的员工（如非生产一线人员全覆盖）。 执行数据： 披露了实际使用灵活办公人数占符合条件人数的比例。 满意度： 披露了针对灵活办公效果的员工满意度调研结果。 1分：合格 提及个别案例或极少数特殊岗位（如孕期员工）可申请。 0分：不满足/无数据 无法证明制度已在实际中得到应用。 灵活工作安排 弹性工时 远程办公 混合办公 居家办公 压缩工时 核心协作时间 弹性工作制度 WFH hybrid work flexible working flexible working hours remote work hybrid work work from home compressed workweek core collaboration hours flexible work arrangement WFH 企业是否定义弹性工时、远程办公或压缩工时等具体形式？ 适用岗位、申请流程与审批权限是否明确？ 是否建立结果导向考核或核心协作时间等配套？ 披露了多少符合条件员工实际使用灵活办公？ 是否有相关满意度结果？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '灵活工作安排'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否定义弹性工时、远程办公或压缩工时等具体形式？ 适用岗位、申请流程与审批权限是否明确？ 是否建立结果导向考核或核心协作时间等配套？ 披露了多少符合条件员工实际使用灵活办公？ 是否有相关满意度结果？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有加班管理；仅有育儿假/产假制度；仅有居家办公临时防疫安排；仅有企业文化宣传无制度；区分：灵活工作安排关注远程/弹性办公制度与执行；反歧视政策关注禁止歧视；平等机会措施关注招聘晋升选拔公平流程，三者不可互相替代。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: Zhongyan Property, a subsidiary of the Group, adheres to the service concept of 'owner's needs first, owner 's satisfaction first', strictly implements t h e Beijing Enterprises Zhongyan Property Citizen Service-Hotline Management Measures ( 《北控中燕物 業市民服務熱線管理辦法》 ) and the Owner Satisfaction Evaluation Management Regulation ( 《業主滿意度測 評管理制度》 ), and assigns staff to run the Citizen Service-Hotline. results.section: Improve ESG governance structure / Ensure fulfillment of social responsibility
results.text: We build a systematic ESG governance structure at the governance, management and executive levels. The Board of Directors supervises ESG matters and assumes overall responsibility for ESG strategies and reporting, and authorizes the Audit Committee to be the professional committee for overseeing ESG management. The Audit Committee regularly reports to the Board of Directors on major issues related to ESG work; the management is responsible for the specific implementation of ESG strategies and goals. The ESG functional departments of the headquarters form an ESG working group, which is responsible for the development of specific ESG work in their respective work areas; each subsidiary conducts ESG work in its territories under the guidance of the ESG working group. The establishment of the ESG governance structure ensures that the environmental and social risks involved in various businesses are managed, and enables the effective implementation of ESG concepts and strategies.

results.text: Logistics transportation is an important intermediate link for hazardous waste disposal. (3) Management of hazardous waste transportation

[Content]

ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TO HELP MAINTAIN ECOSYSTEM HEALTH

[Content]
In order to strengthen the requirements of safety, environmental protection and occupational health management, the Group has established longterm management mechanism of Health, Safety and Environment (HSE). In 2021, the Group has formulated regulatory documents such as t h e Accident and Incident Management System ( 《事故事件管理制度》 ), the Insurance Management System and the Safety Reward ( 《安全獎懲及問責制度》 ), and the Punishment and Accountability System ( 《 保 險管理制度》 ) to standardize the basic management of safety and environment in project companies and strive to enhance the autonomous control ability of project companies.
